U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission plans November 9 data roundtable

capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/us-securitie
s-and-exchange-commission

The SEC wants feedback on machine-understandable data and Super Intelligence.

November 9 is a discussion to follow, not a rule change to assume.

Watch: Listen for concrete examples of use, a clear account of risks and costs, and any stated next steps.

These are watchpoints for the discussion, not promised agenda items or conclusions.

Analysis, not financial advice.

Readers decide whether to trade.
